# Policymaker iteration 0067

Task #388 is done and merged as commit 24a97d2. The check passed, so the change was accepted without the owner.
The task added four draft files under `benchmark/native/job/` for capability #169 (native jobs).
The author model was mainly codex gpt-6.1-sol (GPT family): 513k input tokens and 20 turns.
The self-test exited 0 and rejected five mutations. No Docker or LabVIEW job ran, so no native result exists.
Evidence: `.github/loop/data/session-reports/388/dcd87a90….json`.

I ordered one task: `review-native-job-388` (reviewer, medium, 50 min/35 turns, starts from main, no exports).
It checks the clause map against the #169 readiness text and checks the workflow safety settings.
It also disables each self-test check in a temp copy to confirm that the self-test then fails.
Expected gain: an accept or revise verdict with numbered findings.
On accept, the next Policymaker files one Owner question with the install steps. On revise, it fixes the files by script.
The reviewer also checks the gap from #388: the upload has no HTML output, so a separate session cannot compare diagrams.
Wake is false. The next Policymaker reads the review verdict.

Benchmark readiness is not established. Native evidence, the split store review (#379 pending) and owner method acceptance are still missing.
Quality is not measured. Product implementation stays gated.

## Discoveries
The draft upload leaves diagram HTML on the runner, so the #169 comparison clause can stay unmet. See [#388 report](../.github/loop/data/session-reports/388/dcd87a90a7711f22f0244e0cc5ed6ef3d5c2d2c0930d26cb8387840d0cd300a6.json).

## What next
- Read the verdict of `review-native-job-388`. Do not run a second review of the same files.
- Owner request #379 (store workflow revision 4) is pending. When the record arrives, order one cross-family record review.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
